transcript: Put lemon on aloe vera and watch what happens. Cut an aloe vera leaf in half and scoop out the clear gel with a spoon. Put it in a bowl and add a teaspoon of cornstarch and a pinch of baking soda. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over it and mix everything well. Aloe vera gel regenerates skin cells and soothes inflammation. It penetrates the deeper layers and repairs what the sun and time have damaged. The cornstarch tightens the skin as it dries creating a lifting effect that closes the pores and evens out the texture. The baking soda gently exfoliates and lifts the layer of dead cells where dark spots settle. And the lemon dissolves accumulated pigmentation and naturally brightens the skin tone. Together they reduce sunspots acne marks and age spots better than expensive creams. Apply it wherever needed let it sit for 10 minutes and rinse with warm water. Do it twice a week. Within a few weeks the spots fade, the marks soften and the skin regains an even tone it had not had in months. Nature does not need to be complicated to be effective. The simplest remedies are often the most powerful ones. Save this recipe. But I want you to understand something. Spots and marks do not appear only from sun nor acne. In Chinese medicine the skin reflects the state of the liver. When the liver is overloaded it produces an excess of melanin that settles as dark spots and what overloads the liver. Stress, the emotions you keep silent, the accumulated tension, cortisol, also directly stimulates melanin production. That is why there are women who take care of their skin with everything and the spots keep appearing because they treat the surface. But what causes the spots comes from within. Write ALO in the comments if you are going to make this and if you want to cleanse your skin from the root. I have spent more than 20 years quietly learning how to do it and everything I know is inside the road back to calm. The link is in my profile.
